source.title: Robonine: Feetech STS3250 smart actuator, evaluation of accuracy, torque and backlash

methodNote: Torque read on a lever: the peak held for a split second, and the highest load held before overload protection cut in. The post gives no lever length, scale accuracy or repeat count: ±0.5 N·m is our estimate, about 10% of the peak.
note: 48 kg·cm peak against a 50 kg·cm rating; 25 kg·cm (2.45 N·m) was the most it held before protection cut in.
